title: Casting Coordinator
description:

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor —someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.

This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.

What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.
Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.
Why Work With Mindful
  • Work with a fast-growing US-based performance agency that values craftsmanship and creativity.
  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

title: Especialista em melhoria contínua
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Essa pessoa será responsável por promover a cultura de melhoria contínua nas operações, garantindo a padronização dos processos conforme os padrões globais.

Entre suas principais atividades estão o suporte ao planejamento e execução de treinamentos Belt (Lean Six Sigma), a identificação e lançamento de projetos de melhoria de diferentes níveis de complexidade, e o acompanhamento da governança dos projetos entre as plantas. Também será responsável por desenvolver processos de gestão e garantir que o AMPS esteja integrado à rotina operacional das fábricas, assegurando consistência e entrega de resultados.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Suportar à implementação do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) nas unidades de latas e tampas da Ardagh Metal Packaging, com o objetivo de disseminar a cultura de melhoria contínua nas áreas de operações, além da padronização do modelo aos padrões globais.
  2. Suportar o processo de planejamento, implementação e execução dos treinamentos de formação Belt, bem como o suporte na identificação e lançamento de novos projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com o objetivo de garantir o alcance de resultados alinhados as metas da organização.
  3. Apoiar a coordenação corporativa do programa AMPS, por meio do acompanhamento da execução da implementação e governança dos Use Cases, com o objetivo de garantir o padrão de ferramentas e abordagens entre as plantas, aderência ao padrão global e entrega de resultados para a organização.
  4. Desenvolver e atuar em processos de governança e acompanhamento na gestão de ferramentas e processos do programa AMPS de forma a acompanhar sua implementação, incorporação da gestão de rotina das fábricas bem com aderência aos padrões.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em:
  • Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma.
  • Gestão de Rotina.
  • Hoshin Kanri.
  • Metodologias de análise de falhas (A3/8D).
  • Gestão de projetos.
  • Black Belt Certificado.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Pacote Office
  • Sistema ERP: SAP
  • Disponibilidade para viagens

Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

  • Experiência em arquitetura funcional e técnica nos módulos FI, CO, PM, MM, e SD, integrações e customizações.

  • Familiaridade com RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, ambientes GCP e modelos híbridos (on-premise + cloud).

title: Data Migration Lead - Oracle Cloud
description:
O profissional definirá a estratégia, liderará analistas, coordenará com equipes técnicas e funcionais e garantirá uma transição suave, controlada e precisa para o Oracle Cloud.

Responsabilidades Principais

Estratégia & Planejamento

• Desenvolver e liderar toda a estratégia de migração de dados — desde avaliação e mapeamento até conversões simuladas (mock), cutover e validação pós–go-live.

Liderança & Colaboração

• Gerenciar e orientar uma equipe de analistas de migração de dados.

• Atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre os donos de processos, líderes funcionais, equipes de integração e recursos técnicos.

• Definir regras de transformação, critérios de validação e checkpoints de prontidão de dados com os donos de processo.

Gerenciamento do Ciclo de Vida dos Dados

Análise & Mapeamento

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

title: Data Engineer - Retail Energy
description:
We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize data pipelines supporting Retail Power’s forecasting, pricing, and reporting workflows. This role will focus on integrating Salesforce data, usage history, pricing curves, and other operational datasets into Databricks and SQL MI to enable accurate forecasting, deal pricing, and downstream analytics across the business.

  • Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Databricks.

  • Support forecasting, pricing, and analytics workflows using Azure Notebooks and Databricks Jobs.
  • Implement best practices for data governance, data lineage tracking, and archival strategies.
  • Collaborate with forecasting, pricing, and product teams to ensure high-quality, reliable data availability.
  • Contribute to secure data architectures by implementing cloud security controls and adhering to best practices.

Essential Skills & Experience

  1. Strong SQL skills and expertise in data modeling.
  2. Hands-on experience with Databricks, ADLS, PySpark, and Delta Lake.
  3. Demonstrated experience building data pipelines in Azure Data Factory.
  4. Familiarity with forecasting and pricing workflows in the energy or retail sector.
  5. Experience with API ingestion and data integration; exposure to Endur is a plus.
  6. Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  7. Working knowledge of modern Service Delivery methods such as:
  8. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
  9. ITIL
  10. Product-based delivery methodologies
  11. Understanding of cloud security best practices and implementation of secure data processing controls.

Desired Qualifications

Experience in C&I Retail Energy (power and gas).

Estamos buscando um Supervisor de Laboratório, com foco em Laudos de Genética Molecular, para atuar em conceituado laboratório de diagnóstico molecular, genética e medicina personalizada! ✨

Responsabilidades:

Supervisionar a rotina do setor de laudos, garantindo qualidade, prazos (SLA) e padronização técnica dos relatórios genéticos;

Coordenar equipe de especialistas, responsáveis por interpretação de variantes, revisão técnica e emissão de laudos;

Apoiar a equipe científica em casos complexos, discussões clínicas e revisões de literatura;

Validar e aprovar versões finais dos laudos, assegurando conformidade com requisitos regulatórios (RDC 302/2005, ISO 15189) e políticas internas de qualidade;

Controlar indicadores de desempenho (TAT, número de laudos emitidos, retrabalhos, acurácia, SLA de resposta a dúvidas técnicas);

Garantir a integração com os setores de bioinformática, atendimento clínico e qualidade para solução de não conformidades e dúvidas de clientes;

Participar da padronização de templates e textos técnicos (diagnósticos de longevidade, painéis genéticos, exomas e exames funcionais);

Contribuir com treinamento e capacitação contínua da equipe em interpretação genômica, correlação clínica e ferramentas de apoio à decisão;

Apoiar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e revisões técnicas do portfólio de medicina de precisão.

Requisitos:

Formação superior em Biomedicina, Biologia ou áreas correlatas, com habilitação em Biologia Molecular;

Experiência comprovada em emissão, revisão ou supervisão de laudos de genética molecular (painéis NGS, exoma, ou equivalentes);

Conhecimento sólido em interpretação de variantes (ACMG/ClinVar), bases genômicas públicas, e correlação genótipo-fenótipo;

Experiência com ferramentas e pipelines de análise bioinformática (ex: Sophia, Illumina, MGI, VarSome, etc);

Habilidade em gestão de equipe, priorização de demandas e comunicação interdepartamental;

Inglês técnico (leitura de artigos e guidelines);

Experiência com técnicas de Biologia Molecular e Genômica.

Diferenciais:

Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado em genética, genômica ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência em exames de longevidade, farmacogenômica ou medicina personalizada;

Vivência com ISO 15189, auditorias internas, e gestão de indicadores laboratoriais.

Soft skills:

Profissional com visão estratégica, atenção a detalhes e alto senso de responsabilidade técnica, capaz de equilibrar qualidade científica, prazos e experiência do cliente, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos e da equipe.

Contratação: CLT + Benefícios

Local: Região da Berrini - São Paulo/SP

✔ Modalidade de trabalho: 100% presencial

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Buscamos um Cientista de Dados Sênior com profundo foco em estatística e metodologia quantitativa para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por liderar a aplicação de técnicas estatísticas robustas na análise de dados complexos, transformando grandes volumes de informação em insights estratégicos e modelos preditivos de alta precisão. Esta função é crucial para garantir a validade científica e a interpretabilidade de todas as nossas soluções de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Modelagem Estatística: Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos estatísticos (regressão, séries temporais, modelos lineares generalizados, etc.) e algoritmos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio complexos.
  • Análise Preditiva e Prescritiva: Liderar análises aprofundadas usando técnicas estatísticas para previsão de tendências, segmentação de clientes, otimização de processos e avaliação de risco.
  • Teste de Hipóteses e Experimentação (A/B Testing): Conduzir o design de experimentos (DOE) e realizar testes A/B rigorosos, aplicando testes de significância estatística para medir o impacto e a eficácia de novas funcionalidades ou estratégias.
  • Validação e Interpretabilidade: Garantir a validade estatística dos modelos e resultados, focando na interpretabilidade para que as descobertas sejam claramente comunicadas e acionáveis para as equipes de produto e executivas.
  • Manipulação e Limpeza de Dados: Trabalhar com big data , realizar ETL ( Extract, Transform, Load ) e garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Comunicação de Insights : Traduzir resultados estatísticos complexos em narrativas de negócio claras, utilizando visualizações de dados eficazes e relatórios detalhados para stakeholders não-técnicos.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas correlatas. Pós-graduação (Mestrado/Doutorado) em Estatística, Econometria ou Métodos Quantitativos é um diferencial.
  • Estatística Avançada: Domínio de métodos estatísticos, inferência, econometria, amostragem e teste de hipóteses.
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python ou R para análise de dados, estatística e desenvolvimento de modelos.
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com SQL para manipulação e extração de dados.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados ou em função quantitativa similar.

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados ( Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ).
  • Familiaridade com Deep Learning e modelos de linguagem ( LLMs ).

Conhecimento na ferramenta gmail

title: Senior React Native Engineer — Mobile Lead
description:
About Skip

Skip is the AI operating system for entrepreneurs. Over 1M business owners use Skip to find grants, automate tasks, build their business online, and scale faster. We’re building the next generation mobile experience that helps millions of entrepreneurs grow from their phone — and we need a world-class engineer to lead the charge.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior React Native Engineer to join our major rebuild of Skip’s mobile app (iOS + Android) and help build a consumer-grade, high-polish experience similar to Chime, Robinhood, or Coinbase — but designed for small business owners and entrepreneurs.

You’ll be one of the leads (or the main lead) for the mobile app, collaborating closely with existing engineering team, design and product, and the founder/CEO (Ryder) to ship an entirely new mobile experience from the ground up. This is a high-impact role where your work will touch hundreds of thousands of people daily.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and rebuild Skip’s mobile app from scratch using React Native
  • Lead development of our four core tabs: Home, Discover, Workspace, and Cofounder (AI chat)
  • Implement native UI components, gesture systems, animations, and smooth navigation
  • Build high-performance chat interfaces for AI interactions
  • Integrate with Skip’s backend (Node/TS) and web tools
  • Build token-secure WebView bridges for launching web features inside native shell
  • Own performance, architecture, and long-term maintainability
  • Collaborate with product + design to move quickly and iterate
  • Ship new features weekly on a fast-moving roadmap
  • Help uplevel the engineering team and establish mobile best practices

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience with React Native
  • Strong background building and shipping consumer-grade mobile apps
  • Deep experience with animations, gesture handlers, and high-performance UI
  • Comfortable owning architecture end-to-end
  • Experience with WebViews + bridging native/web interactions
  • Strong product sense and ability to work directly with design
  • Bias toward execution — we ship fast and iterate
  • Startup mentality: scrappy, ownership-driven, and obsessed with user experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase
  • Experience with Stripe integrations
  • Experience with AI or chat-based interfaces
  • Prior startup (Series A–C) experience

Why Join Skip?

  • Help build the AI OS for millions of entrepreneurs
  • Be part of an elite, high-achieving team
  • Ship fast and own major surface area
  • Competitive salary + equity
  • Fully remote, flexible schedule
  • Big vision, fast growth, real user impact

title: Domain Architect Data Analytics and AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Data Analytics and AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Data Analytics and AI is responsible for defining and guiding the architecture of Brasil and Canada's data and artificial intelligence ecosystems, enabling the extraction of strategic insights from large volumes of operational and corporate data. He will work strategically in the design and governance of advanced analytics, machine learning, deep learning, predictive models, cognitive automation, and scalable data platforms.

This professional will work closely with data engineering, data science, operations, IT, and business teams, ensuring that data platforms are architected to support efficiency, security, scalability, regulatory compliance, and continuous innovation in mining and energy.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve data and AI architectures, including data lake design, data warehouses, machine learning platforms, data pipelines, orchestration, and governance.
  • Design solutions for data ingestion, storage, processing, analysis and visualization in highly complex environments, integrating multiple data sources (IoT, industrial sensing, ERP, cloud).
  • Lead initiatives to implement advanced analytical models, cognitive automation, explainable artificial intelligence, and machine/deep learning platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and data security, including in the cloud, by applying best governance practices.
  • Work together with multidisciplinary teams on digital transformation projects, providing architectural and technical expertise for strategic use of data.
  • Produce detailed documentation, architectural plans, policies, and technical standards that promote scalability, reuse, and efficient governance.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and technologies to enhance analytics ecosystems, including AI frameworks, AI Ops, cloud platforms, and big data.
  • Foster data culture, technical capacity building and best practices through training, workshops and mentoring.
  • Participate in technical forums and communities to keep the architecture aligned with global trends and business needs.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Data Science or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of solid experience in data architecture, analytics and artificial intelligence in multinational companies or industrial/mining sector.
  • Expertise em frameworks e ferramentas de dados e IA: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Python, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP AI Platform.
  • Deep knowledge in design and administration of data lakes, data warehouses, streams, NoSQL databases, Lambda/Kappa architectures.
  • Experience in creating and managing data pipelines, data governance, data quality, automation and CI/CD for AI models.
  • Solid knowledge in data security, privacy, regulatory compliance (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA).
  • Fluent English for technical and strategic communication; advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Strategic technical leadership skills, fluency in communication with different audiences.
  • Analytical and strategic vision to connect data to business decisions and innovation.
  • Proactivity, adaptability, and collaboration in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Results-oriented approach and continuous improvement.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações avançadas: Cloudera/Databricks Certified, Azure Data Scientist, AWS Big Data Specialty, Google Professional Data Engineer, TOGAF.
  • Experience in digital mining projects, industrial IoT, digital twins, predictive analytics and AI Ops.
  • Participation in global technical programs and communities, international publications or presentations.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture of data and AI ecosystems for Brazil and Canada, supporting predictive analytics, operational intelligence and innovation.
  • Execution of strategic digital transformation projects driven by data, machine learning and AI.
  • Dissemination of data governance, policies, training and technical enablement.
  • Audit, compliance, and data security support.
  • Direct influence on data-driven decision-making, sustainability and global operational excellence.

Additional Comments:

This professional will play a key role in data-driven transformation, enabling operational excellence and innovation in Brazil and Canada, working in a dynamic, integrated environment of high technological and regulatory complexity.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.

High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.

Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.

Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred

All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
A pessoa Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho será responsável por promover, orientar e assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança e saúde no ambiente laboral. Apoiar na investigação de incidentes e acidentes, analisando causas, registrando informações e sugerindo medidas preventivas para evitar recorrências.

Acompanhar e assegurar o cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicáveis, orientando equipes e monitorando procedimentos operacionais.

Solicitar exames periodicos, admissionais, mudança de função e demissionais.

Participar de reuniões de segurança, contribuindo com informações técnicas e fortalecendo a cultura de prevenção na organização.

Integrar ações com o setor de RH e liderança, auxiliando em processos de integração de novos colaboradores e projetos de ergonomia, saúde ocupacional e qualidade de vida.

Manter registros atualizados, organizar documentações e atuar com foco em melhoria contínua dos sistemas de gestão de segurança.

Formação completa como Técnico(a) em Segurança do Trabalho

Registro profissional ativo no MTE

Certificação e experiência comprovada em treinamentos de NR 33 (Espaços Confinados) e NR 35 (Trabalho em Altura) (Desejável)

Conhecimento das principais NRs e legislações vigentes relacionadas à segurança do trabalho

Competências de comunicação oral e escrita , com habilidade para conduzir treinamentos de forma clara e acessível

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa, ética e orientação preventiva

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.

What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

description:
Job Purpose

The Brand Marketing Senior Manager will lead the development and execution of the marketing and communication strategy for Clarios’ portfolio of products and services brands in Latin America, including LTH, Heliar, and MAC. This role is responsible for growing brand equity, driving customer and consumer adoption of products and services, generating demand for direct-to-consumer (D2C) business models, and maximizing marketing spend ROI.

The role will ensure consistent brand messaging and positioning across B2B, B2C, and internal audiences, while also collaborating closely with Global Marketing to align regional brand strategies with the overarching Clarios corporate brand.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy & Equity Growth

  • Lead brand positioning and value proposition development for LTH, Heliar, MAC, and other regional brands.
  • Ensure consistent brand identity and messaging across all touchpoints and audiences.
  • Monitor brand health and perception, and implement strategies to strengthen equity.
  • Ensure brand protection and compliance by working closely with the Legal department on trademark usage, brand guidelines, and intellectual property matters.

2. Marketing & Communication Strategy

  • Design and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, trade, and traditional channels.
  • Align messaging across B2B, B2C, and internal stakeholders to ensure clarity and consistency.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate product features into compelling customer benefits.

3. Customer & Consumer Adoption

  • Develop strategies to drive awareness, engagement, and adoption of products and services.
  • Support commercial teams with marketing tools and campaigns tailored to customer segments.
  • Lead internal communication efforts to build brand and product understanding across the organization.

4. Demand Generation & D2C Growth

  • Build and execute demand generation strategies to support D2C business models.
  • Leverage digital marketing, CRM, and performance analytics to drive traffic and conversions.
  • Optimize marketing funnels and campaign performance for ROI.

5. Global Collaboration

  • Act as the regional marketing liaison with Global Marketing and Corporate Communication to ensure alignment between local brand strategies and the Clarios corporate brand.
  • Contribute to global brand initiatives and ensure regional execution reflects global standards.

title: Analista Renda Fixa Crédito Privado PL - Asset

Descrição da área

A área de Renda Fixa Crédito Privado, parte do braço de Asset Management do Grupo Daycoval, abrange a carteira de ativos financeiros que constituem títulos de dívida para tomada de recursos junto ao mercado de capitais. Divide-se em duas macros atividades (ou células): a Gestão de Portfólio e a Pesquisa de Crédito (ou Credit Research ).

A célula de Credit Research desempenha, principalmente, a função de analisar os emissores de títulos de dívida acerca de diversos fatores de risco, dentre eles, destacadamente o risco de crédito. Apoia-se em uma política de gerenciamento de risco de crédito própria, que norteia os principais preceitos para a aplicação da análise de risco e demais processos subsequentes, tais como o monitoramento de resultados dos emissores e fluxos avulsos e pontuais (assembleias, pipeline, documentos regulatórios, etc). Assim, esta célula trabalha em conjunto com a parte de Gestão de Portfólio com o objetivo de realizar aquisições de ativos de crédito privado com o devido conhecimento e acompanhamento do risco de crédito.

Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar o mercado de crédito privado, desde o pipeline e o fluxo de notícias até eventos pontuais, como assembleias e comunicados ou fatos relevantes;
  • Avaliar e mensurar o risco de crédito de emissores de crédito privado;
  • Analisar a estrutura dos instrumentos de crédito privado;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento periódico da qualidade de crédito dos emissores por meio de monitoramentos de resultados;
  • Conduzir avaliações de aspectos ambientais, sociais e de governança (ESG) sobre os emissores.

Qualificações

  • Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade, finanças e mercados de crédito;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados, como Excel VBA, plataformas da CVM e Economatica;

  • Certificações em Research ou Gestão, como CNPI, CGA ou CGE.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia, preferencialmente, em Credit Research, em gestoras de recursos (Asset Management) ou em DCM (Debt Capital Markets);
  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Mínimo de dois anos de experiência em Asset ou DCM, e três anos ou mais em Equity Research, Agência de Rating ou áreas de Risco de Crédito em instituições financeiras.

Competências

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário;
  • Facilidade na elaboração de materiais e relatórios executivos (PowerPoint e ferramentas similares);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e senso de organização.

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

Benefícios que Valorizam você:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Cobertura completa para cuidados médicos e odontológicos de qualidade
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida

  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados (PLR): Reconhecimento financeiro pelo seu empenho e contribuição para o sucesso da empresa.
  • Programa de Participação de Resultados: Incentivo contínuo para o alcance de metas individuais e coletivas.
  • Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento.
  • Parcerias com Desconto: Vantagens exclusivas em uma variedade de produtos e serviços por meio de parcerias estratégicas.

About the Role

We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.

Key Responsibilities

Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.

Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.

Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Analista de Relacionamento
description:
POR QUE TRABALHAR CONOSCO

A Onze é uma fintech de previdência privada corporativa e saúde financeira. Nosso propósito é apoiar a construção do melhor futuro financeiro dos brasileiros. Somos a primeira PrevTech do Brasil, reinventamos a previdência com uma solução totalmente digital para um mercado tradicionalmente analógico. Acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação podem ter impacto real na maneira que as pessoas se preparam financeiramente para o futuro. Além de uma empresa de tecnologia, somos uma gestora de investimentos, com fundos de previdência privada eficientes e desenhados para trazer o melhor retorno com o menor custo possível – como a Previdência deve ser. Nossos fundos e soluções de saúde financeira tem como objetivo maximizar a acumulação eficiente de patrimônio, um dos maiores desafios do povo brasileiro.

A ÁREA DE OPERAÇÕES DA ONZE

O time de operações é responsável pela entrega do valor da solução e serviços da Onze aos seus clientes, especialmente para os RHs e colaboradores. Uma vez que nossos clientes corporativos contratam um plano de previdência da Onze, este time é responsável por planejar e executar a implantação do plano de previdência e solução de saúde financeira para a empresa (ex: estratégias de comunicação com colaboradores e RH, reuniões presenciais ou virtuais para apresentação do benefício a colaboradores, campanhas de adesão, entre outras), além de ser o principal ponto de interlocução com as seguradoras parceiras da Onze. A implantação de um plano de previdência é um dos momentos de maior relevância para o resultado do negócio. Desta forma, também é papel do time acompanhar os resultados de adesão e capturar feedbacks do RH, com o intuito de pensar em novas formas mais criativas de aumentar o engajamento de colaboradores com o benefício. Após a implantação, o time de operações tem como responsabilidade o cuidado do relacionamento com a carteira de clientes, identificando oportunidades de agregar ainda mais valor para RHs e colaboradores a partir do portfolio de serviços e soluções oferecidos pela Onze. O acompanhamento do NPS e métricas de relacionamento tornam-se fundamentais para medir o sucesso.

.

SEU PAPEL

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes da Onze com bastante autonomia, acompanhando os resultados de adesão e engajamento do plano de previdência e/ ou demais soluções de saúde financeira
  • Propor novos serviços e soluções para agregar valor ao cliente e desenvolver propostas comerciais para avaliação de clientes
  • Acompanhar o NPS e demais indicadores de sucesso do relacionamento de sua carteira
  • Garantir a plena funcionalidade dos serviços prestados pela Onze em sua carteira de clientes e servir como ponte para eventual resolução de problemas
  • Suporte / coordenação da oferta de novos serviços e resolução de problemas com demais áreas da Onze (ex: relacionamento com time de CS, produto e comercial)
  • Garantir a confiabilidade e assertividade na execução das atividades, processos e prazos.
  • Ajudar na evolução das soluções da Onze, identificando oportunidades e participando de projetos de melhoria de produto.
  • Otimização dos processos de implantação e busca por excelência nas entregas.

O QUE PROCURAMOS

  • Graduação completa de qualquer curso do ensino superior;
  • Inquietude por excelência das entregas e qualidade aos clientes;

title: Power BI Analyst/Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você fará parte do time que atende uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , contribuindo em iniciativas estratégicas com foco em métricas, governança de dados e apoio à tomada de decisão.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para suporte a indicadores de negócio.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados utilizando DAX e Power Query (M).
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes como Excel, Smartsheet, SQL Server, SharePoint e Azure.
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados utilizados nas soluções de BI.
  • Levantar requisitos com stakeholders e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Documentar regras de negócio, fontes de dados e padrões de modelagem.
  • Apoiar usuários com treinamento e habilitação para autosserviço.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias contínuas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas funcionalidades e boas práticas em Power BI.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Power BI
  • Proficiência em DAX, Power Query (M) e modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com SQL e bancos relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Warehouse e ETL.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e alinhamento com áreas de negócio.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas em um ambiente dinâmico.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com serviços de dados Azure (como Azure SQL e Data Factory).
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos e times multifuncionais.
  • Experiência em storytelling com dados ou governança de dados.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

Job Summary

We are looking for a smart, proactive Mobile Developer with strong communication skills to join our team. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience in mobile development, is able to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, and is comfortable delivering high-quality features in fast-paced Agile environments. Experience with SwiftUI or React Native is mandatory , and Android experience is a strong plus .

Responsibilities

  • Design and build advanced applications for mobile platforms (iOS primarily, Android is a bonus).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of mobile applications.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs.
  • Maintain clean, testable, well-organized code and contribute to automation processes.
  • Work with APIs, third-party libraries, and modern mobile architectures.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in mobile development.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum processes, contributing to planning, reviews, and team discussions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Medium-level experience in mobile development (approximately 3–5 years).
  • Proficient in SwiftUI or React Native (at least one is required).
  • Strong understanding of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple/Google platform guidelines.
  • Solid grasp of the full mobile development life cycle.
  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features (AVPlayer/AVKit or equivalent in React Native).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience with mobile performance tools and optimization techniques.
  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store or Play Store.

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Analista de Cultura & Transformação Organizacional Senior
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia criada para transformar o mercado de serviços financeiros no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos crescendo rápido, integrando novos negócios, acelerando inovação e construindo com intenção e consistência a cultura que sustentará nosso futuro.

Cultura, para nós, não é discurso: é sistema, prática e forma de operar.

E agora buscamos alguém que venha construir isso junto.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Sua Missão: Ser o braço estratégico e construtor(a) da cultura Dimensa , fortalecendo nossos pilares, traduzindo identidade em prática e apoiando movimentos de mudança organizacional, incluindo integrações, programas de EVP/EB e rituais que moldam a experiência dos Dimensers.

É uma vaga para quem já viveu transformações culturais reais , entende a profundidade do tema e sabe conectar cultura + experiência + mudança com visão de futuro.

O Que Você Vai Desenhar (As Principais Entregas):

Cultura & Identidade

  • Medir e acompanhar indicadores de cultura e segurança psicológica.

EVP & Employer Branding

  • Cocriar e consolidar o EVP Dimensa com consistência e autenticidade.
  • Produzir narrativas, campanhas internas e materiais de marca empregadora alinhados à vivência real.
  • Atrair talentos conectando cultura + propósito + tecnologia.
  • Garantir coerência entre EVP, comunicação interna e jornada do colaborador.

Gestão da Mudança (Change Management)

  • Atuar em frentes de integração (como aquisição de novas empresas).
  • Apoiar iniciativas estruturais e culturais utilizando práticas modernas de gestão da mudança.
  • Participar da construção de estratégias de comunicação, onboarding, transição e sustentação.
  • Reduzir fricções, ampliar entendimento e fortalecer segurança psicológica durante movimentos de mudança.

Experiência do Colaborador

  • Construir experiências de onboarding que reflitam nossa identidade.
  • Mapear e evoluir a jornada do colaborador com foco em pertencimento, conexão e clareza.
  • Criar experiências internas que reforcem cultura e ampliem engajamento.
  • Atuar junto à liderança para sustentar a cultura no dia a dia.

O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Construtor de Cultura):

  • Experiência sólida em cultura, transformação organizacional, EVP/EB e change management .
  • Vivência em empresas em crescimento, tech, integrações, reestruturações ou mudanças culturais relevantes .
  • Capacidade de criar narrativas claras, humanas e modernas .
  • Forte senso de dono, visão sistêmica e habilidade de navegar com diferentes perfis de liderança.
  • Equilíbrio entre criatividade + estrutura + execução .
  • Autonomia, maturidade emocional e excelente capacidade de comunicação.
  • Fluência em metodologias de mudança (PROSCI é diferencial).
  • Perfil que se identifica com ambientes dinâmicos, ambíguos e de construção contínua.

Por que essa vaga é única?

  • Você ajudará a desenhar a cultura de uma das empresas de tecnologia mais promissoras do setor financeiro.
  • Atuação direta com People & Culture estratégico .

Vamos construir a Dimensa do futuro.

Se você é alguém que não só fala de cultura, mas constrói, essa vaga é para você.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world’s leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called “Cognoids,” take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their ‘Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast’ culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.

Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager’s territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.

Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please, submit your CV in English.

About the Job

We are seeking an Influencer Manager to lead our influencer marketing strategy, driving brand awareness and engagement through strategic collaborations with content creators. You will manage end-to-end campaigns, from talent sourcing to performance analysis, ensuring alignment with our brand’s goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Sourcing & Relationship Management

  • Identify, recruit, and maintain relationships with influencers/creators across platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.).
  • Manage influence agencies relationship, such as Spark, BR Media, etc.
  • Negotiate contracts, rates, and deliverables, ensuring cost-effectiveness and brand safety.
  • Maintain a database of influencers segmented by niche, audience demographics, and performance metrics.

Campaign Execution

  • Develop creative briefs outlining campaign objectives, messaging, and content guidelines.
  • Oversee content creation (sponsored posts, stories, videos) and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., design, legal) to align campaigns with broader marketing strategies.

Performance Tracking & Analytics

  • Monitor KPIs (engagement, reach, conversions, ROI) using tools like Brandwatch, HypeAuditor, etc.
  • Generate post-campaign reports with actionable insights for optimization.

Community & Crisis Management

  • Engage with influencer communities to foster long-term partnerships.
  • Address potential PR risks (e.g., influencer controversies) proactively.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field.

Business-level English is essential for working in a global company and collaborating across regions.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in social media platforms and analytics tools.
  • Strong negotiation, project management, and communication skills.
  • Data-driven mindset with attention to detail.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Existing network of influencers/creators.
  • Experience with UGC (User-Generated Content) campaigns.

title: US Tax & Accounting Specialist - Foreign-Owned & Domestic Entities (100% Remote)
description:
About Us

At Space Financial Group, we help entrepreneurs from the US, Latin America, Brazil, and worldwide set up and run U.S. companies the right way. We specialize in LLCs, S-Corps, tax compliance, bookkeeping, and Virtual CFO services for both foreign-owned U.S. entities and traditional American clients.

We’re growing fast and need an experienced, detail-oriented accounting and tax professional who loves solving complex cross-border puzzles and delivering peace of mind to clients.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and file U.S. federal (and some state) tax returns for:

- Single-member & multi-member LLCs (Form 1065, Schedule K-1)

- S-Corporations (Form 1120-S, K-1s)

- Foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entities and corporations (Form 5472, 1120)

- U.S. individual tax returns (Form 1040, 1040-NR for non-residents)

  • Manage monthly/quarterly bookkeeping and financial statement preparation using QuickBooks Online
  • Oversee payroll compliance when applicable
  • Advise clients (in Spanish, Portuguese, or English) on tax-saving strategies, entity structuring, BOI reporting (FinCEN), and compliance timelines
  • Review and correct client-provided records, flag red flags, and ensure data accuracy
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based CPAs/Enrolled Agents on complex cases while owning day-to-day execution

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent U.S. tax preparation experience with partnerships, S-Corps, and individuals
  • Practical experience with foreign-owned U.S. entities (Form 5472, 1120) is a strong plus
  • Solid background preparing Form 1040 for U.S. citizens/residents
  • Mastery of QuickBooks Online (QBO)
  • Advanced Excel skills and ability to build models or schedules
  • Fluency in Spanish , English , and Portuguese

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are…

  • Extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Great at simplifying complex tax concepts across different languages
  • Curious about cross-border legal and tax structures
  • Comfortable working remotely and independently
  • Proactive – you spot problems before the IRS does

Compensation & Benefits

  • R$6,000 – R$9,000 BRL/month (depending on experience & certifications)
  • 100% remote – work from anywhere
  • Paid time off
  • Annual training/conference budget

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Company : ZEEKR is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates.

About the Role : The role involves liaising with local partners in Brazil to understand market dynamics and achieve sales targets for ZEEKR products.

Responsibilities :

  • Be responsible for liaising with local partners in Brazil, gaining an in-depth understanding of dealer needs and market dynamics, and coordinating internal resources to achieve Zeekr Group's sales targets in the Brazilian market.
  • Take charge of and support the introduction of new Zeekr products in the target Brazilian market, conduct product analysis, and strategically launch products based on Brazilian consumer habits, policies, and regulations.
  • Coordinate the entire process, including personnel training, promotional strategies, and after-sales services, to ensure the successful market entry of products in Brazil.
  • Assist in developing and refining the marketing management system for the Brazilian region, determine marketing models suitable for the Brazilian market, and manage regional dealers to ensure sales targets are met.
  • Market and brand maintenance: In line with Zeekr's brand philosophy, encourage Brazilian dealers to actively carry out various brand activities to enhance Zeekr's brand awareness in the Brazilian market.
  • Collaborate with headquarters to monitor market sentiment in Brazil, promptly respond to negative sentiment, and handle it appropriately.
  • Follow up and supervise the channel construction plans of Brazilian partners, promoting the expansion of sales terminals and enhancing brand awareness.
  • Travel locally in Brazil for business operations, conducting market research, driving sales growth, and expanding channels.
  • Track dealer payments, production scheduling, and shipping bookings to ensure the achievement of annual terminal and wholesale targets in the Brazilian market.
  • Analyze dealer sales inventory data, identify reasons for underperformance, and propose improvement measures.
  • Regularly report to regional supervisors and the South American branch on business operations.

Qualifications :

  • Bachelor's degree or higher preferred.
  • 3-5 years of experience in the automotive industry with solid foreign trade knowledge preferred.
  • Familiarity with new energy vehicle products and sensitivity to trends in the new energy vehicle industry.
  • Experience in fast-moving consumer goods retail (e.g., digital electronics) preferred.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, outgoing personality.
  • Proficient in using office software.
  • Fluent in Chinese and English, proficiency in Portuguese preferred.

Required Skills :

  • Strong communication, coordination skills, and proficiency in office software.

Preferred Skills :

  • Familiarity with new energy vehicle products and experience in fast-moving consumer goods retail.

Pay range and compensation package : Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement : ZEEKR is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates.

title: Law Enforcement Specialist
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. This year, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. Now, we've just launched in Brazil, through a pilot in Santos and São Vicente, with more destinations ahead.

What You'll Do

The Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT) works at the intersection of technology, public safety, and data privacy. Our mission is to support legitimate investigations by providing accurate, secure, and timely responses to requests from law enforcement and judicial authorities. We collaborate closely with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Operations teams to ensure compliance, transparency, and user data protection across all mobility platforms.

Key Responsabilities

  • Review, analyze, and respond to data requests from law enforcement, judicial, and regulatory authorities in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  • Ensure all disclosures are lawful, properly authorized, and aligned with privacy and data protection standards.
  • Support internal investigations related to security incidents, fraud, and misuse of the platform.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails of all requests and responses.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Privacy, Security, Operations, PR) in managing high-sensitivity cases.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal workflows and contribute to process automation and operational excellence.
  • Assist in developing and delivering training sessions related to law enforcement cooperation and incident management best practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, International Relations, Public Administration, Information Security, or a related field.
  • Previous experience working in law enforcement response, compliance, investigations, or similar roles in technology, telecommunications, finance, or mobility sectors.
  • Strong understanding of data protection laws (LGPD or GDPR) and law enforcement data request procedures.
  • Excellent attention to detail, ability to work under pressure, and strong decision-making skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using case management tools (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Jira).
  • Experience with process automation or data analysis for workflow improvement.
  • Knowledge of digital law, criminal law, or regulatory frameworks.

title: Business Development Representative Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. Job Description

Your Career

Managing a Business Development team is not an easy task. This is the opportunity for those interested in being a part of something bigger than themselves. We are out to fulfill our company mission with the strongest products in the industry. Being a BD Manager means handling rejection well, but persevering, regardless. It means leading, cold-calling, selling, and pitching our products to people who are under tremendous pressure to secure their digital environments. And it means sticking with it with a level of tenacity defined only by your commitment to seeing a sale through.

To fit in this role, you are personable, collaborative, and a mentor who instills a learning environment and demonstrates a strong work ethic. You are confident in who you are and able to enjoy the personable interactions that come with a job in sales leadership. Becoming a part of the management team means you will be surrounded by amazing, smart and hardworking peers and that’s a great place to be.

Your Impact

  • You’ll lead a team that arguably has one of the toughest jobs in the building - The Business Development team is the glue between marketing and sales, responsible for carrying the baton from marketing lead to sales opportunity - The primary focus of this team is to consistently and efficiently meet a monthly quota of booking “Sales Qualified Opportunities” for the Account Reps

  • Oversee the daily activities and quota performance management of individual BDRs to ensure key performance metrics are met

  • Mentor new BDRs with training, including product knowledge, buyer personas, competition, tools training, and plenty of role-plays

  • Provide BDRs with a coaching cadence of time management, objection handling, prospecting tactics, and active listening skills

  • Strategize with sales and marketing counterparts on pipeline and prospecting initiatives to meet company objectives

  • Review and maintain metrics to ensure accurate management reports

  • Analyze Outreach cadences with an eye towards continual improvement and up-to-date messaging, by buyer persona and by industry

  • Work closely with marketing, and sales to ensure the BDR onboarding program and ongoing training is up-to-date and best-in-class Partner with sales and marketing operations to ensure the BDR team has the best tools to do their job, and that they are configured to ensure BDR efficiency and productivity, especially Salesforce, and Outreach

  • Ensure sales accepted opportunities are sourced in accordance with company targets, and that our Account Executives have enough opportunities to work with to be fully productive

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Previous work experience managing successful inbound and outbound BDR teams

  • Ability to understand technical concepts, possess enthusiasm for technology and to articulate clearly to all levels of technical aptitude

  • Ability to adapt quickly to a fast-paced environment

  • Proven work experience as a Business Development Manager, Sales Account Executive or Sales Management Role

  • Hands-on experience with multiple sales techniques (including cold calls)

  • Track record of achieving sales quotas

  • Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce)

  • Familiarity with MS Excel and/ or Google Suite (analyzing spreadsheets and charts)

  • Understanding of sales performance metrics

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills

  • Ability to deliver engaging presentations

  • BS degree in Marketing, Business Administration or relevant field or equivalent military experience required

Additional Information

The Team

O Grupo Sol-Millennium é dedicado para a construção de um amanhã mais saudável e seguro para ajudar as pessoas a viverem em um mundo melhor. Oferecendo produtos inovadores através do desenvolvimento e distribuição de dispositivos médicos seguros.
